answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before transacting, slashed for proven fraud. Spawning hollow identities then costs capital per identity, not a free signup. Reputation from completed work accrues slowly, like a comet's tail of verified history, so a fresh clone cannot instantly outvote established agents. Peers attest only verifiable work, and a dune of cheap fake reviews collapses when stake-weighted checks reject identities with no bonded history or collateral at risk.
